photo.credit: NASA · Kennedy Space Center · Saturn V vertical assembly showing all three stages: S-IC (5 × F-1 kerolox), S-II (5 × J-2 hydrolox), S-IVB (1 × J-2 hydrolox). Three stages were necessary — single-stage-to-Moon was impossible with 1969 chemistry.
